name: Thorn Bamboo
subtitle: Village Hedge
mechanism: Wall. Every time it is hurt, every grounded enemy within thorn_radius takes thorn_damage, so each Kim Bong Carpenter sweep (10 damage per 0.8 s) costs the carpenter 12. Event-driven: no per-frame work.

abilities.name: Thorn Back
abilities.effect: Deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2 m.

clipAnnotations.die: Squash and shrink into the lawn.
